approval_events_reason_ck.name: approval_events_reason_ck
approval_events_reason_ck.value: decision = 'approve' OR (reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(reason)) > 0)

payout_actions_row_ck.name: payout_actions_row_ck
payout_actions_row_ck.value: (kind = 'release' AND row_index IS NULL) OR (kind = 'pay_row' AND row_index >= 0)

payroll_runs_kind_ck.name: payroll_runs_kind_ck
payroll_runs_kind_ck.value: (kind = 'payroll' AND advance_id IS NULL) OR (kind = 'advance' AND advance_id IS NOT NULL)

workflow_configs_approvers_ck.name: workflow_configs_approvers_ck
workflow_configs_approvers_ck.value: (kind = 'one' AND approver2_user_id IS NULL) OR (kind <> 'one' AND approver2_user_id IS NOT NULL AND approver2_user_id <> approver1_user_id)
